report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; only one of four samples (344ms) is elevated while others are 62-78ms. Traces show successful downstream calls with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause; the single latency outlier is insufficient. Operator hypotheses (pool exhaustion, redis timeout, downstream latency) are not supported by current data, so hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis to localize the 344ms outlier
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
DB connection pool wait/acquire metrics to test pool exhaustion
Redis operation latency/timeout metrics to test redis-timeout
Deployment/version history for gateway and downstream services
